Purpose: show exactly how the supplied source message changed Version 5 of the documentation and presentation.

## Source record

- Author: Bob J Mills.
- Supplied artifact: `9755c3bfec1c898947b240937f902e73e6a35f9e.webarchive`.

- Integration date: September 2026.

## Core source proposition

Mars will not be settled by intelligence alone. It will be settled by rapid ideation and practical engineering that turn intelligence into reliable, verifiable and accountable action.

The model supplies intelligence. The harness supplies mission capability.

## Evidence reconciliation

The source uses Observed, Derived, Assumed and Unknown as evidence classes. In the integrated Version 5 architecture they are treated as epistemic statuses:

- Observed: a direct instrument, physical test or field record.
- Derived: a calculation or inference from evidence.
- Assumed: a provisional input awaiting confirmation.
- Unknown: an unresolved question that blocks or bounds a decision.

Provenance is recorded independently as literature, simulation, physical test, field observation or mission decision. This prevents a label such as “simulation” from being mistaken for a confidence level and allows every status to retain its actual source.

## MOXIE evidence boundary

NASA/JPL reports 16 oxygen-producing runs, 122 grams of oxygen in total, 12 grams per hour in the most efficient run and oxygen purity of at least 98 percent. These are presented as observed mission results. They establish oxygen-production feasibility on Mars, not continuous duty cycle, crew-scale output, stack lifetime, dust tolerance, storage integration, maintenance interval or redundancy.

Primary verification source: https://www.jpl.nasa.gov/images/pia26041-the-sound-of-moxie-at-work-on-mars/

## Presentation integrity

- Slide 15 uses verified agency facts.
- Slides 16–17 use clearly disclosed illustrative engineering work products.
- All consequential actions remain subject to human approval.
- No platform-portability claim implies identical performance or controls across AI runtimes.
- The source webarchive is retained in the package for provenance.


---

## Version 5 integration

The “AI path to Mars” is now expressed as an intelligence layer rather than a single application: specialized science, engineering, and execution harnesses; portable skills; runtime-independent work contracts; controlled evidence classes; local autonomy during delay/blackout; and field evidence that can reopen research or design.
